what: With the section pinned to the screen, cards fly in one at a time from deep below (y 1000px · z 750px · rotateX 90°, perspective 1000), lie flat, and stack overlapping (1.5 beats power2.out, 2-beat interval). Earlier cards are pushed up 50px each time a new card arrives, so their top edges show layer by layer. Meanwhile the big title behind shrinks to .7x. Once everything is stacked it rests .3 beat, then the cards pull out −50vh at .15-beat intervals (1.8 beats power2.inOut) and the whole section fades. 1 beat = Screen 30% scroll, scrub 1

options.dur: Beat at which one card flies in, default 1.5
options.lift: Px each front card is pushed up per card, default 50
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards — stacked on top of the cell
options.[data-fx-part=title]: (If any) large title behind the cards

note: With reduced motion, stack titles and cards vertically
